desc: The Master Bench Block Pro stands as a testament to innovation in firearms maintenance, designed to facilitate the disassembly and assembly of a wide range of firearms. Its robust, overmolded footprint is compatible with most pistols, long guns and gun parts, ensuring a stable platform for precise work. With 14 strategically placed holes and two grooves, the block offers unparalleled flexibility, allowing for easy alignment and secure handling of firearm components during maintenance tasks. This tool’s effectiveness is further amplified by the Smart-Block Clamps, a revolutionary feature that locks down parts firmly, thereby preventing any movement and ensuring stability during pin punching. Constructed from high-quality engineering-grade resin, the Master Bench Block Pro is durable, non-marring and designed with an embedded magnet to securely catch and hold pins, eliminating the frustration of lost components. Whether for professional gunsmiths or DIY firearm enthusiasts, this bench block is an essential tool that promises to simplify and improve the maintenance process, providing confidence and efficiency in every task.
